reasoning_content:
The segfault is now resolved. The issue was libgeotiff/libspatialite linking against libproj.so.22 (old proj 8). After the full apt upgrade, everything rebuilt against libproj.so.25. GDAL import now works.

Let me verify the full test suite again and the end-to-end run.
